decisions.reason: The source also changes the sensor-board prototype dimensions and connector-access layout, but a complete same-message MODIFY already records both effects.
The source also establishes the power board's vertical installation, flexible prototype dimensions, and connector-access preference, but a complete same-message MODIFY already records these effects.
The general preference for accessible top or side connectors does not necessarily replace the battery connector's specific back placement opposite USB-C.
The source concerns physical board dimensions, orientation, and connector access rather than the sensor-module connector inventory or electrical interfaces.
The source changes mechanical connector placement preferences but does not change the interboard connector types, pinouts, or power and signal topology.
Board orientation and connector accessibility do not change the I2C cable, pull-up, resistor, or signal-conditioning requirements.
The source does not change the panel power button connector, its main-board assignment, or its PWRON control behavior.
The mechanical layout guidance does not change the BOOT button, reset connection, or associated capacitance requirements.
The source does not change the selected ESP32-S3 module or its breakout behavior.
The source does not change USB-C enumeration or programming functionality.
Mechanical board orientation and connector access do not change the monitored rails, monitoring IC, channels, or measurement coverage.
The source does not change the DCDC1 output voltage, target rail voltage, or Schottky-drop compensation requirement.
